title: Diagonal extraction from nested infinite cliques
statement: Let C : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop be any family of binary relations C r on ℕ. Suppose that for every r ∈ ℕ and every infinite set I ⊆ ℕ there is an infinite set J ⊆ I such that C r j l holds for all j, l ∈ J. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that C r (φ(r + 1)) (φ(r)) holds for every r ∈ ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ (C : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop), (∀ (r : ℕ) (I : Set ℕ), I.Infinite → ∃ J ⊆ I, J.Infinite ∧ ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ l ∈ J, C r j l) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r, C r (φ (r + 1)) (φ r)
